description: Parking Vélos Île-de-France Mobilités is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Description: Couche géographique décrivant les Parkings Vélos Île-de-France Mobilités. Définition Les Parkings Vélos Île-de-France Mobilités sont un service de stationnement de vélos offrant des abris en libre-service et des consignes collectives sécurisées à proximité des gares et stations franciliennes. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Vélos & Nouvelles mobilités. Its keywords are Vélo, Stationnement, Données géographiques, Plateforme numérique, Collectivité, Parking Vélos. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
